reviews.author: Lee Anna Farrall
reviews.text: Mike replied to my email request for an estimate on the same day. He and his assistant made needed non-emergency repairs the next day. They were professional and efficient. Rates were reasonable. Definitely recommend Cedar Run Plumbing and I would use them again.

reviews.author: Welsey Harper
reviews.text: We had a leaky pipe and contacted Cedar Run Plumbing based on their reviews. Mike came out the same day that we called him, even though it was after business hours. He was prompt and thorough and fixed our problem right away. He is very knowledgeable and gave us great advice on not only our plumbing issue, but answered our questions regarding a reverse-osmosis water system. We will definitely contact him for future issues and would HIGHLY recommend him to friends and family.

reviews.author: Bert Morris
reviews.text: My friend who’s a contractor recommended calling Mike from Cedar Run. Man, it’s good to have friends in the know! Mike came over in about an hour & a half (can you say “fast service”?). He fixed my dishwasher and installed my new garbage disposal in a little over an hour. And he charged me a very reasonable price. Now I know who to call for any plumbing needs I may have in the future. Mike’s the man!

reviews.author: Christine N
reviews.text: On time, efficient, quality work and good prices! We have used Cedar Run several times and have never had any problems with their work. They clean up and leave the are spotless. Extremely professional and easy to work with, will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Martha Kelly
reviews.text: Cedar Run Plumbing LLC was great to work with. They were more than on time, they arrived early! They were quick to identify our small leak and repaired it efficiently! I would highly recommend them! Thank you Cedar Run!

reviews.author: Second Nature Customs LLC
reviews.text: We have been using Cedar Run Plumbing for over a year now on countless remodeling projects. They take all of the pain out of the plumbing aspects for us. They have always shown up on time and I have never had to second guess their work. They have found and corrected issues without even being asked. I send them to all of my customers with plumbing needs and they too are beyond satisfied with the work performed. I couldn't ask for a better contractor to cater to my business needs!!

reviews.author: Janice Wolfe
reviews.text: Mike and Cedar Run Plumbing is reliable and reasonable. We have used them for years and will continue to do so. It is very hard to find an honest and reliable plumber and with Mike and Cedar Run Plumbing you not only have that but you have so much more. Highly recommend Mike and Cedar Run Plumbing for all your plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Kelsey Springer
reviews.text: Cedar Run Plumbing, LLC provided great service with a recent frozen pipes issue at our home. The technicians arrived in a timely manner and worked efficiently to solve the problem. We are very happy with the service we were provided and will use Cedar Run for any future needs!

reviews.author: Christine P
reviews.text: Mike is great. He recently came to repair our outside hose faucet. He was quick and very efficient. Mike knows his stuff. He has been our plumber for a number of years. He recently came to replace a part in one of our toilet tanks. promptly came and got in fixed in no time flat! reliable and reasonable rates. Thanks Mike!! Mike also came in May to replace a gas wall heater unit and he did a great job again. Mike always does accurate work.

reviews.author: Chris Orem
reviews.text: Had a valve break in the middle of the night. Was referred to Cedar Run Plumbing by a local supply store. Because of the problem, we had to shut off our main water, so we needed someone quick. Mike fit us into his schedule and within an hour of calling he was there. Less than a half hour later he had replaced the valve. The cost was reasonable and I intend to use him for future work. I would very much recommend Cedar Run Plumbing based on my experience.

reviews.author: Eugene Oliver
reviews.text: My wife called Cedar Run to fix a leaky sink issue. Not only did they quickly and professionally deal with the problem, we received excellent advice regarding our sink configuration and products to look at when we decide to switch out faucets. Reasonable pricing and we will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Jessica Shipe
reviews.text: Mike, from Cedar Run Plumbing, came out on a Saturday and replaced our hot water heater. He was quick and courteous, and knew his job well. I would refer them to anyone who needs a plumber. I am very happy with the service and will use them again.

reviews.author: Lynn Marie
reviews.text: DO NOT EVER USE THIS COMPANY! Poorly completed jobs and work done half way are the hallmarks of Cedar Run Plumbing. Temporary "fixes" are all these guys are good at... anything "they fix" will need to be fixed again correctly within 6 months! Also, all of these reviews were bought and are not honest reviews since this company gives customers a discount off their bill to leave a positive review!

reviews.author: Normandy Carrier
reviews.text: Cedar Run was very prompt in arriving and fixed my broken pipe in a timely manner. They were very courteous and nice and I was very satisfied with the bill. I will call them again and would recommend them to anyone. Great job! Ronald & Normandy Carrier/Broadway, VA

reviews.author: Mike Pompeo
reviews.text: Mike has done plumbing work in my home several times. Very knowledgeable as well as reasonably priced, honest, prompt and does clean work. I would highly recommend Cedar Run Plumbing. Thank's Mike!

reviews.author: Karen
reviews.text: Had a great experience with Mike from Cedar Run Plumbing of Weyers Cave today. Had an issue with toilet backing up into the shower, so gross. They don't always work Saturdays, but Mike was able to come today and charged less than half of the phone estimate from a Harrisonburg Company. He was able to come quickly and it didn't take him long at all to have our plumbing back to normal.

reviews.author: WBTX Radio
reviews.text: Mike has done plumbing work in our home several times. Each time we have called him, he was quick to respond. His work is excellent. Mike his very reliable, honest and reasonable pricing.

reviews.author: Bill
reviews.text: We are very happy to have engaged Cedar Run Plumbing on several occasions. Service has been quite prompt and reasonable. We have received value for what we have paid. We have recommended Cedar Run to our friends, and they too are pleased. We recommend Cedar Run to you too.

reviews.author: Beth Morris
reviews.text: Mike was very punctual and professional. He came to assess the renovation project that I'm doing and gave me an estimate within the day. The estimate was reasonable and he had the work done within the week. I recommend them to anyone looking for pluming work and will certainly call them again regarding my other renovations. Thanks Mike!

reviews.author: Lisa Shoemaker
reviews.text: Mike and his crew are dependable, honest, and experts in their field. We were in the middle of a remodel when we called Mike. He came in and finished our job. The previous work failed inspection and Mike fixed it and finished the job promptly while keeping his other commitments. Mike is very reasonable with cost and extremely efficient with time. He is our "go to" plumber for all of our rental property needs. He is the owner and respects each of his customers. You cannot go wrong with choosing this company to do all of your plumbing work. Mike is the BEST!!

reviews.author: Josie Kinkade
reviews.text: These guys responded to our sewer emergency within an hour. They had to get creative with a solution. When one of our ancient cast iron pipes broke off in an awkward place, they had to do two different repairs to get it not to leak, but they only charged for one of them. Their total bill was quite reasonable for the amount of work they put into it. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Simone Dustin-Hess
reviews.text: Mike diagnosed a problem that was difficult for other experienced plumbers to figure out. He is very knowledgable. His priced matched his estimate exactly. They were easy to reach via phone and prompt to arrive. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jesse & Maria Rodriguez
reviews.text: I had a pressure tank that was slowly leaking. Called them up, said they could come out the next morning. During the day, they had a cancellation and were at my house within 45 minutes. Job was done in under and hour and the technicians were friendly and helpful when I had questions about other things. I definitely recommend them to anyone looking for hassle-free, fast service!

reviews.author: C Cruz
reviews.text: We had a leak in our water line that was coming up through the ground in our driveway! I called Mike from Cedar Run Plumbing that night, and he was at our house the crack of dawn the very next morning (which was wonderful being we barely had any water). He came out and capped off the pipe for us. I was expecting the bill to be HUGE being he had to dig up the driveway, cut the pipe and all of that crazy stuff... but it was less than $100! Not only was Mike great, but the price was super affordable! Highly recommend everyone to go here!

reviews.author: John Marr
reviews.text: Mike and his team at Cedar Run are quick, professional, and reliable. They are also personable and will give you their honest opinions and suggestions. Great people and fair prices make this an awesome local business to support. I wish I could give them more than 5 stars.

reviews.author: Dan Cullers
reviews.text: Mike goes the extra mile, making early and late calls, to take care of his customers. He services nine rental units for us, and we have been pleased with every job he has done. Affordable and reliable.

reviews.author: Evelyn Sampson
reviews.text: We own an older home and have had different plumbing issues over the years. Cedar Run Plumbing has always taken care of any problem quickly and professionally.

reviews.author: Laura K
reviews.text: I first got in touch with Mike from Cedar Run Plumbing through another contractor to look at my renovated old rental house in Harrisonburg in February of 2015. The pipes were freezing up in 2 of the 3 bathrooms and in the kitchen because of poor renovation work done before I bought the house. At that time he made a visit to look at the situation and made recommendations. He did not charge me. Over the next 18 months he fixed some small problems for me (such as the outside faucet that I had another plumber install before I met Mike--the other plumber installed it wrong so that water stayed in the faucet and froze, breaking it, during the first winter after I had it installed.) After another visit last fall which I was not charged for, we scheduled to have the pipes rerouted. He gave me an estimate of $500, and although two of his men were at the house for over 4 hours that day (we had to open up several places in the walls to find exactly how the pipes were routed,) he charged me quite a bit under the estimate. I cannot say enough about Mike's work ethic, honesty, and fairness, not to mention his plumbing expertise. I wish I lived in the area so that I could have him work on my own home!

reviews.author: Christopher Smith
reviews.text: Cedar Run was quick to get us scheduled and showed up on time. They were knowledgeable, friendly, and provided quality service. We will definitely be contacting them for any future needs!

reviews.author: Bc Drawn
reviews.text: I had Cedar Run Plumbing come out to unclog a sink and bathtub. I was not only over charged, but both the sink and bathtub were clogged again in just a couple of days even though I had barely used them. I was very disappointed. I called numerous times for them to come back out but I never heard from them again. Stay away from Cedar Run Plumbing at all costs.

reviews.author: Jean DePiro
reviews.text: There is nothing like having a clogged garbage disposal when you have company coming for dinner within hours! One phone call to Cedar Run Plumbing and they were at my house within the hour! Excellent service. Thank you for coming to my rescue!!

reviews.author: Lori Mongold
reviews.text: Mike came out the same day that I contacted him on two separate occasions very prompt service and extremely reasonable. I will definitely use this service in the future.

reviews.author: Jennifer Matthaei Cottrell
reviews.text: Mike is an absolute pleasure to work with. He does excellent work at excellent prices. I would highly recommend Cedar Run Plumbing to anyone needing plumbing help!

reviews.author: Asa Nienstadt
reviews.text: I called on a Thursday and got scheduled for the following morning at 8 am. Mike came in and fixed my leaking water heater in twenty minutes. Fast and professional service.

reviews.author: Dianne Fulk
reviews.text: They came in and replaced 3 leaking faucets quickly in my rental property so that the new tenants could move in on time! Excellent to work with! Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ross Erb
reviews.text: Our water heater was giving erratic water temps. I called and they were able to come that same day and quickly repaired the problem. I couldn't have asked for faster service, and a bill was reasonable.

reviews.author: Bryan Hill Farm
reviews.text: Cedar Run Plumbing was prompt and professional. Have used them in the past and will refer them to others. It is also great to support a local business.

reviews.author: Julie Morehead
reviews.text: I was out of town when my husband called Cedar Run, but he was very happy with them. They were friendly, knowledgeable, and he says we will definitely call them again when we have a problem.

reviews.author: Tia Mingle
reviews.text: Responded very promptly to our issue, even though we called first thing in the morning. He was very professional and friendly. We highly recommend him. He clearly had experience and fixed our problem within an hour.

reviews.author: Sara Nafziger
reviews.text: Michael does quality work at a reasonable charge. He has done multiple jobs for me in the last year and I have been happy with his work.

reviews.author: Kristy Zirkle
reviews.text: This is the BEST Plumbing business... They are very prompt with service, extremely reasonable prices and great customer service!!! We have used this company for years and have ALWAYS been impressed.

reviews.author: John Austin
reviews.text: Best Plumbing company in town. I've used them several times and I have always been pleased with their work!

reviews.author: Beulah Warf
reviews.text: Good work and quick service. My phone call was answered right away and Mike was able to come the next day for non-emergency service. Would use again in the future.

reviews.author: Casey Thomas
reviews.text: They were quick, professional and did a great job. I highly recommend them to anyone who needs a plumber.

reviews.author: Andrea Greco
reviews.text: A friend recommended Cedar Run Plumbing, and I was happy with their service. They quickly diagnosed and fixed the problem!

reviews.author: Heather Denman
reviews.text: Responded promptly to my call both times I have needed service. Very professional, efficient and reasonably priced. Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Katrina Washington-Hall
reviews.text: Quick service, reasonable pricing and no over charging. Great and quality work. Very satisfied. Would recommend to a friend :-)

reviews.author: Oliver Hyman
reviews.text: Efficient. Cost effective. Nice job. Would be nice if they cleaned up a bit more, but other than that very happy. Would definitely hire again.

reviews.author: Debbie Baker
reviews.text: Used Mike for years. Reliable, and I can always count on him to come when he is needed. Thanks, Mike

reviews.author: Greg Justice
reviews.text: He was very knowledgeable and took time to explain to me what he was doing. Furthermore, they are priced right.

reviews.author: Roy Dove

reviews.author: Ina Funkhouser
reviews.text: Highly recommend this company for anyone looking for quick response, quality work and reasonable pricing!
